newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong brokerages trade 4 bln yuan in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong brokerages trade 4 bln yuan in Shanghai.

text.p: Hong Kong-based brokerages traded four billion yuan in foreign currency B shares on the Shanghai stock exchange in 1996, accounting for 42.28 percent of B share turnover, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.
The brokerages have participated in the underwriting of 24 of the 45 B share issues listed in Shanghai since the market was created in 1991, the newspaper said.
They have a total of 12 B share trading seats on the Shanghai exchange, accounting for about 30 percent of the total seats on the bourse controlled by foreign brokerages, the newspaper said.
Major players include Sun Hung Kai Investment Services Ltd, Jardine Fleming Securities Ltd, Peregrine Investments Holdings Ltd and Credit Lyonnais Securities (Asia) Ltd, it said.
